caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a rectangular shape, consisting of two side panels and a front panel. The front panel is divided into three upper square sections and one long rectangular section beneath. The entire front surface is decorated with intricate, swirling floral and leaf motifs etched into the wood. The three upper panels are each bordered, with the central one featuring the letters “E X G” surrounded by decorative patterns, while the two outer panels display symmetrical floral designs. The chest is rendered in mostly red-brown hues, with darker brown tones used for shading and contrast, emphasizing the carved patterns and borders. The background is plain and a light beige color, with no additional objects present, and the chest is shown at a slight angle to reveal the left side, which is plain with simple borderlines. The chest stands on four short legs, one at each corner.
title: Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
